name: Robert D. Boyd
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
education: West Virginia University College of Law
about: Robert D. Boyd attended law school and graduated from West Virginia University College of Law in 1983. Robert Boyd began practicing law in 1983.

Robert Boyd is an attorney at Boyd Collar Nolen Tuggle & Roddenbery, helping people with Family Law issues. Boyd Collar Nolen Tuggle & Roddenbery has an office in Atlanta, Georgia, serving the local community.

Robert Boyd was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
